title: What Do You Want to Be?
subtitle: 考点：职业与理想 / want to be / because
passage: Four students talk about their dream jobs. Jason wants to be an engineer because he loves building things. He made a small bridge from sticks last month, and it was strong enough to hold a heavy book.
Tina wants to be a fashion designer. She draws clothes in her notebook every day, and she often makes new dresses for her dolls. “I want to make clothes that make people feel confident,” she says.

Their classmate Alex likes taking photos and hopes to become a photographer. He takes pictures of birds in the park every weekend. Mia wants to be a lawyer because she wants to help people. She often reads about law in the library. Their teacher says every dream is good, but they must work hard. “Study well now, and try your best every day,” she says.
